The view at end of Q3 2026
Own the control plane. Rent the components.

GenAI in a regulated firm is not a model choice. It is a control system: who may call what, on whose behalf, at what cost, with what evidence, and how to leave a vendor without starting again.

This book grew from a LinkedIn series that took the enterprise GenAI stack apart one layer at a time, from foundation models to evaluation, and paired each layer with the control that makes it safe. Each chapter opens with the post, then goes behind it: the evidence, the trade-offs, what good looks like, the honest objections and the questions to take to your team.

One worked example runs throughout and grows chapter by chapter: an agent that drafts a fund's monthly performance-attribution commentary, with a portfolio manager approving every draft.

  • Nine layers and eight controls, each in a short, self-contained chapter
  • A worked example built step by step, from the brief to sign-off
  • The signal to measure for every layer, with a starting target
  • Questions to take to your team, chapter by chapter
  • Vendor-neutral judgement, backed by sourced footnotes
